notes.title: **Patch 11**

notes.title: **Patch 10**
notes.content:
- **Wiz Final Phase Bug Fixed**: Resolved a bug that occurred when completing a level with Wiz.
- **Bat Score Error Fixed**: Corrected an issue with the score calculation for defeating bats.
- **Boss Score Error Fixed**: Addressed a bug related to score calculation when defeating the boss.
- **Rain Added**: A new rain effect has been introduced to enhance the atmosphere.

Thank you for your ongoing support and feedback!

notes.title: Patch 8
notes.content:
**Patch 8**

- **Totem Animation Adjusted**: Improvements made to the totem's animation.
- **New Animation for Kaelan's Space Arrow**: Kaelan's space arrow now features a brand-new animation.
- **Performance Issues Fixed**: Resolved performance problems that caused the game to freeze.
- **General Bug Fixes**: Additional minor bugs have been addressed.

Thank you for your continued feedback and support!

notes.title: Patch 7
notes.content:
**Patch 7**

- **New Totem Feature Added**: When the character falls, it's now possible to activate a totem and restart from the midpoint of the level.
- **Score Counter Bug Fixed**: Resolved an issue where the score counter would reset unexpectedly.
- **Leaderboard Name Duplication Fixed**: Addressed a bug that allowed the same name to appear multiple times in the Top 5 rankings.
- **General Bug Fixes**: Additional minor bugs have been corrected.

Thank you for playing and sharing your feedback!

notes.title: Patch 6
notes.content:
**Patch 6**

- **Fixed Duplicate Sound Issues**: Resolved problems with duplicated sounds during gameplay.
- **Adjusted Fire-Throwing Character**: Improved mechanics for the character that throws fire through windows.
- **Leaderboard Issues Fixed**: Addressed a problem where the leaderboard sometimes failed to display correctly.
- **Steam Language Auto-Detection**: The game now automatically detects the language set in Steam during the first installation.
- **Minor Bugs Fixed**: Additional small issues have been resolved.

Thank you for your continued support and feedback!

notes.title: Patch 5
notes.content:
**Patch 5**

- **Boss Dialogue Adjusted**: Improvements have been made to the dialogue with the boss character.
- **End-Level Mechanics Updated**: The mechanics for completing a level have been refined.
- **Boss Defeat Bug Fixed**: Resolved an issue that occurred when defeating the boss.
- **Sound Adjuster Improved**: Enhancements made to the sound settings.

Thank you all for your feedback and support!

notes.title: Patch 1
notes.content:
**Patch 1**

- **New Mascot Added**: The new mascot has been introduced to the game.
- **Improved Damage Mechanics**: Falling now causes 1 point of damage, and the player is reset to the start of the map.
- **General Bug Fixes**: Various bugs have been identified and resolved.

If you encounter any issues, please report them to us. Thank you for your support!
